Setup

## Set up in a minute

Once you've signed up and verified your email, add RenderPixels to your AI assistant. After that, ask for images in any chat.

- In Claude, open Settings, then Connectors, and choose Add custom connector .

- Name it RenderPixels and paste the MCP server URL.

- Click Connect, sign in with your RenderPixels email and password, then click Authorize.

- Run this in your terminal:

claude mcp add --scope user --transport http renderpixels https://renderpixels.com/mcp

- In Claude Code, run /mcp , pick renderpixels and choose Authenticate .

- Sign in with your RenderPixels email and password in the browser, then click Authorize.

- In ChatGPT, open Settings, then Apps, and turn on Developer mode under Advanced.

- Create an app named RenderPixels, paste the MCP server URL, and choose OAuth for authentication.

- Sign in with your RenderPixels email and password, then click Authorize.

- Ask your Bot :

Connect to the MCP server at https://renderpixels.com/mcp and use it to render images.

- Your Bot builds the connector and keeps it for later chats.

- When the RenderPixels sign-in page opens, sign in with your email and password, then click Authorize.

- Add the MCP server URL as a remote MCP server with the Streamable HTTP transport.

- Let your AI assistant sign you in with OAuth: use your RenderPixels email and password, then click Authorize.

RenderPixels has no API keys, so an AI assistant that can't sign in with OAuth can't connect.
